description: For each recorded change to an entity, compare performance in the window before the change against the window after it (default 14 days each side). Returns before/after KPI windows and per-metric relative deltas (CTR, CPC, conversion rate, cost-per-conversion, etc.). This is a directional pre/post comparison, NOT a controlled experiment. It is confounded by seasonality, the LinkedIn learning phase after edits, and concurrent budget changes; present it as a signal and call out partial after-windows on recent changes.

windowDays.description: Days on each side of a change (default 14)

name: compute_lift
